title: The Shape-and-Volume Harbor
learning_focus: Properties of solids, liquids, and gases; measuring mL/L; temperature-caused state changes.
story_premise: The harbor’s storage system fails because containers were chosen without considering shape and volume.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Properties of solids, liquids, and gases; measuring mL/L; temperature-caused state changes.

areas.title: Shape Pier
areas.story: Compare definite and changing shapes. Measure liquid volumes with a beaker or cylinder.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The station in Shape Pier is not working correctly.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe carefully, investigate Properties of solids, liquids, and gases, record the evidence, and use it to restore the station.

learning_clues: Science focus: Properties of solids, liquids, and gases.
Record observations and measurements before forming a conclusion.
